Shared space storage unavailable: this kernel\u0027s sdcardfs is incompatible with clone spaces, so the gallery stays empty. Tap to generate the fix module
Shared space storage available · Tap to regenerate the fix module

A zip named cubclone-sdcardfs-fix.zip will be written to the Download folder (an existing one is overwritten). Flash it in APatch / KernelSU / Magisk and reboot.

The module does two things:
1. Switches external storage to pure FUSE mounting — with sdcardfs in the kernel a clone volume cannot be mounted at all, which is the root cause;
2. On pure FUSE every read and write is proxied by the system media provider, which cannot modify files left over from the sdcardfs era; apps then fail to open their own databases (import errors, 0-byte exports, endless loading). Once the device is unlocked the module re-owns those legacy files to the local media provider — owner only, no change to content or location, runs once and leaves a marker.

Devices whose kernel has no sdcardfs are rejected at install time and nothing is left behind.

Note: ROM OTA updates usually require re-flashing the module.
